ja: 窓口が閉まる前に来るべきだったなあ。
en: I should have come before the counter closed.
alternatives: I should've gotten here before the counter closed.
I should have gotten here before the window closed.
point: 後悔は should have + 過去分詞。「来るべきだった」

ja: 銀行ではこれは有料ですが、郵便局では無料です。
en: The bank charges for this, whereas the post office doesn't.
alternatives: The bank charges for this, but the post office doesn't.
It's free at the post office but not the bank.
point: 対比は whereas。後半は doesn't で charge を省略

ja: この手続き、どのくらいかかるか教えていただけますか？
en: Would you mind telling me how long this will take?
alternatives: Could you tell me how long this will take?
Do you happen to know how long this will take?
point: how long の後ろは疑問文の語順にせず this will take

ja: 私の書類を確認し終えると、窓口の人は申込書に判を押した。
en: Having checked my documents, the clerk stamped the form.
alternatives: After checking my documents, the clerk stamped the form.
The clerk checked my documents, then stamped the form.
point: 分詞の主語は主節の主語（the clerk）と一致させる

ja: 修理を始める前に、見積もりをもらえますか？
en: Could I get a quote before you start?
alternatives: Can you give me an estimate before starting?
Could you give me an estimate before starting repairs?
point: before の後は未来のことでも現在形（you start）

ja: 郵便局の人が小包は明日届くと言ってた。
en: The clerk said the package would arrive tomorrow.
alternatives: The clerk said the parcel would come tomorrow.
The clerk said the package will arrive tomorrow.
point: said の後の that 節は will を would に揃えることが多い

ja: 私に必要なのは、認証済みの写しです。
en: What I need is a certified copy.
alternatives: A certified copy is what I need.
It's a certified copy that I need.
point: What I need is ～ で「必要なのは～」と強調する

ja: 小包を送るのは、どの窓口ですか？
en: Which counter is for mailing packages?
alternatives: Which window is for mailing packages?
Which counter handles sending packages?
point: 「〜するための窓口」は for のあとを動名詞にする

ja: ここに名前を書いてください。
en: Please write your name here.
alternatives: Write your name here, please.
Please put your name here.
point: 「書いてください」は Please + 動詞の原形

ja: 市役所は土曜日は休みです。
en: City hall is closed Saturdays.
alternatives: City hall is closed on Saturdays.
City hall isn't open on Saturdays.
point: 毎週のことなので Saturdays と複数形

ja: この申込書、手伝っていただけないかと思いまして。
en: I was wondering if you'd help with this form.
alternatives: Would you mind helping me with this form?
I was hoping you could help me with this form.
Could you possibly help me with this form?
point: 丁寧な依頼は I was wondering if で過去形にして和らげる

ja: 私のカード、もう送りましたか？
en: Have you sent my card yet?
alternatives: Have you mailed my card yet?
Did you already send my card?
point: 疑問文の「もう」は文末の yet で表す

ja: もっと速く届く方法はありますか？
en: Is there a faster way?
alternatives: Is there a quicker way?
Is there a faster shipping option?
point: fast の比較級は faster。more fast とは言わない

ja: ATMに長い列ができています。
en: There's a long ATM line.
alternatives: There's a long line at the ATM.
The ATM has a long line.
point: 「列ができている」は There's a long line

ja: 先週申し込んでいれば、今ごろ手元にあるのに。
en: If I'd applied last week, I'd have it by now.
alternatives: I'd have it by now if I'd applied last week.
If I had applied last week, I'd have it now.
point: 過去の原因と今の結果：If had+過去分詞、would+原形

ja: 私たちは今、順番を待っています。
en: We're waiting for our turn.
alternatives: We're waiting in line now.
We're waiting in line right now.
point: 「順番を待つ」は wait for our turn

ja: 私はもう20分、ここで待っています。
en: I've been waiting here for twenty minutes.
alternatives: I've already been waiting here for twenty minutes.
I've been here waiting for twenty minutes.
point: 続いている時間は現在完了進行形＋for

ja: 明日の朝、パスポートを取りに来ます。
en: I'll pick up my passport tomorrow morning.
alternatives: I'll come get my passport tomorrow morning.
I'm coming back for my passport tomorrow morning.
I'll come pick up my passport tomorrow morning.
point: 取りに来る は pick up を使うと自然

ja: 手数料を払わずに済ませる方法はないですよね？
en: There's no getting out of paying the fee, is there?
alternatives: I can't get out of paying the fee, can I?
There's no way to avoid the fee, is there?
point: no getting out of ～ing で「～は免れない」。付加疑問は is there

ja: このペン、お借りしてもいいですか？
en: May I borrow your pen?
alternatives: Could I borrow your pen?
May I borrow this pen?
point: 「借りる」は borrow、貸すの lend と区別

ja: 彼女は窓口で言われたことを覚えていない。
en: She doesn't remember what the clerk told her.
alternatives: She can't remember what the clerk said.
She doesn't recall what the clerk told her.
point: 「言われたこと」は what 節。語順は平叙文のまま

ja: なくしたカード、もう再発行してもらった。
en: I've already had my lost card reissued.
alternatives: I already got my lost card reissued.
I've already gotten my lost card reissued.
point: 「〜してもらう」は have + もの + 過去分詞

ja: カウンターに置いてある用紙にご記入ください。
en: Please fill out the form on the counter.
alternatives: Please fill in the form on the counter.
Please fill out the form that's on the counter.
point: 「置いてある用紙」は the form の後ろに on the counter

ja: 何を持ってくればいいか、教えてもらえますか？
en: Could you tell me what I should bring?
alternatives: Would you tell me what I should bring?
Could you tell me what to bring?
point: what 節は平叙文の語順：what I should bring

ja: 先週申請した私のパスポート、もう届いてますか？
en: Has the passport I applied for last week arrived?
alternatives: I applied last week. Has my passport arrived yet?
Has my passport from last week's application come in?
point: last week があっても、今の状況を聞くので現在完了

ja: 妹は窓口で、もっと情報が必要だと言われました。
en: My sister was told they needed more information.
alternatives: The clerk told my sister they needed more information.
They told my sister they needed more information.
point: information は数えられない名詞、informations や an は不可
